decision_rule: Accept only when confidence >= confidence_threshold and top1_minus_top2 >= margin_threshold.
calibration_status: Confidence 0.50 and margin 0.30 are a conservative usability adjustment evaluated on 1,173 exported held-out plant predictions. They produced 96.85% coverage and 93.93% accepted-result accuracy. Validate on an independent calibration set and unsupported/non-leaf images before deployment claims.
